_about: THE BAR'S RUMOURS (RUN TWO [the bar], rule 80c: the bar is where you hear what a faction wants; Battle Brothers' tavern rumours that mark the map). One is told per round bought, never the same twice in a visit. kind: place (a mark on the map, 'mark' names it), faction (what an outfit is about to do), gear (where good gear is, WORLD [where the god gear is]), keeper (one hook tied to a specific settlement keeper by its 'keeper' field -- smith/armourer/barber/clinic/board; PEOPLE [the keepers speak] and WORDS [the keepers' lines]: filter this list by r.keeper===k to give that keeper his own line, rather than drawing from the shared bar pool). draft:true words, Spanglish from the keeper's mouth; WORDS owns the voice, QUESTS and WORLD feed this file.

rumours.says: They say the pump on Lake Mead Boulevard still runs at night. Nobody admits to paying for it.
Road crew took the corner by the wash again. Six of them, one with a pistol, the rest pipes. They want the whole wash by the end of the month.
A trucker swore he saw a dog with a tag in its ear, big as a calf, out by the tower. From the lab, pues.
Somebody is buying copper by the Strip and paying in real batteries. The caravans are about to make a move on it. Too good, if you ask me.
The old riot squad left a locker in the copper sheds. Full plate, if the rats did not get it. Nobody goes because of what lives there.
The church wants the water rights at the fort. They are paying anybody who walks a cart for them, and paying worse to anybody who gets in the way.
A guy came through trying to sell me a gun that still had a factory seal on it. Did not ask where he got it.
Somebody is selling car doors off a whole lot out past the wash. Real cheap, if you do not ask why.
A woman asked me for the same haircut three different men had, same week. I did not ask why either.
A man came in talking about a chip under his skin, swore it kept him alive once. I did not look. Gracias a Dios, some things stay closed.
There is a contract nobody has posted yet. Something about the old robotics plant by the airport. Not ready to talk about it.
